## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when applicable
- [ ] No credentials, precise user locations, production data, or licensed data are included

## Risk and rollout

Describe data-provenance or safety implications, migrations, feature flags, monitoring, and rollback steps. Write `None` where an item does not apply.

## Evidence

Include screenshots for UI changes or sample requests and responses for API changes.
